name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for drywall replacement?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for drywall replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for drywall replacement, prioritize those with proven experience in similar projects and positive client references. Verify they are licensed and insured in California to protect yourself from liability. Request a detailed, written estimate that outlines all costs, materials, and the project timeline. Look for clear communication, professionalism, and a commitment to quality workmanship, including proper surface preparation and finishing techniques.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed and insured contractor with proven experience, good references, and a detailed written estimate. Look for clear communication and quality workmanship.
